intro.text: Now we go down a row. N sits below J for your right index finger, and B is a stretch down from F for your left index finger.
intro.tip: B is closer than it looks – stretch from F, not from your whole arm, then come back home.

steps.title: Meet B and N
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: fbf jnj fbf jnj bbb nnn bin ban nab bone
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Real words
steps.instructions: Every word uses only keys you have learnt.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: the brown rabbit ran into the barn; ben found a blue bottle; always be bold; bananas are good;
a big band began to play; the baby is sound asleep; bring your notebook and a banner;
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
